bds.h: Dolores Huerta, labor activist and civil rights icon, dies at 96
bds.lede: Dolores Huerta was a labor activist and civil rights leader who co-founded the group that later became the United Farm Workers.
rows: Dolores Huerta was a labor activist and civil rights leader who co-founded the group that later became the United Farm Workers.
Dolores Huerta, who co-founded the United Farm Workers, has died at 96, her family said.
Huerta fought for farm workers' rights in the 1960s and 1970s and had continued to work addressing immigration and voting issues.
Huerta co-founded the United Farm Workers union to improve working conditions in the nation's fruit and vegetable fields and coined the phrase “Sí, se puede!” that became a widespread rallying cry.

Dolores Huerta, who co-founded the United Farm Workers union to improve working conditions in the nation's fruit and vegetable fields and coined the enduring “Sí, se puede!” rallying cry, has died. She was 96.
Huerta co-founded the United Farm Workers, improving the lives of the country's mostly Latino farmworkers and changing the course of the labor movement.
